extracted.intended_audience: public relations practitioners / communications professionals using AI to write and send press releases
extracted.subtask_description: Guide for creating, editing, and pitching press releases using AI tools: covers how to provide inputs, set tone, customize drafts, select media contacts, and craft email pitches and subject lines. Focuses on practical steps to make AI-generated press releases journalist-ready and aligned with brand and audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choose press release type
rubrics_metrics.description: Start by choosing the type of your press release - is it a product launch? A survey or report you'd like to publish? Or is this press release announcing something?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selecting the correct type informs the AI's drafting approach and the questions it will ask later (e.g., survey vs product launch will trigger different follow-ups and story angles).

rubrics_metrics.name: Pick target audience
rubrics_metrics.description: Pick your target audience. There are predefined options, such as industry players or customers, but you can also add your own to make your press releases stand out even more with specially targeted information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audience selection affects tone, content emphasis, and which journalists/beat contacts the AI will recommend; be specific to improve relevance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choose language (contextual translation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Choose the language you want to write it in. The system translates in a contextually relevant manner, different from Google Translate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use language selection to widen reach for international clients and to pitch local media; prefer contextual translations to preserve nuance and brand voice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide three specific key messages
rubrics_metrics.description: Power up the press release maker with three key messages you'd like to share. Be as specific as possible and ensure that whatever you choose is the most relevant information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These key messages can be turned into highlight quotes; more detail yields better AI output but keep clarity and focus since custom questions and draft content are based on them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Answer journalist-focused questions and provide evidence for claims
rubrics_metrics.description: AI will ask more in-depth questions (about ten) designed to mirror a natural conversation with the journalists you’re targeting, e.g., whether a product was clinically tested or what proof backs a claim.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide concrete supporting information (data, testing, proof points, pricing comparisons) to reduce follow-up questions from journalists and ensure the press release aligns with reporters' needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Set tone and voice consistent with brand and audience
rubrics_metrics.description: Set the tone and voice for your press release — formal, friendly, etc. — remembering press releases are part of your branding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose tone based on audience and context (e.g., friendly for a younger-targeted product launch; professional or empathetic for crisis management) to reinforce brand image and increase resonance with recipients.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customize and edit the draft; adhere to the Five Ws
rubrics_metrics.description: After drafting, adjust formatting, content, and length; ensure messaging is clear and concise while adhering to the fundamental principles of the 'Five Ws': who, what, when, where, and why.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the editor to fine-tune headline, lead, and facts; ensure facts answering the Five Ws are explicit so journalists can quickly identify newsworthy elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use AI assistant's suggestions (11 key criteria) to polish content
rubrics_metrics.description: An AI Assistant trained in PR writing best practices reviews the draft and suggests improvements based on 11 key criteria, indicating exactly where to edit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow or selectively apply AI suggestions; you can regenerate or rewrite sentences/paragraphs, change length or tone, and accept edits at sentence/paragraph level to improve clarity and quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select and verify media contacts; check profiles
rubrics_metrics.description: Use AI-recommended journalist contacts (the platform offers a media database and personalized contact suggestions based on keywords in your press release).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manually vet suggested contacts by checking their contact info, recent work, and social media profiles to ensure an appropriate fit; AI broadens reach but human verification improves match quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Draft pitch emails with four key bullet messages
rubrics_metrics.description: Let AI draft the email pitch based on your press release; the pitch will include four key messages written in bullet points for easy scanning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat the AI draft as a preliminary pitch to be personalized; attach or embed the press release; bullets help journalists scan the newsworthy points quickly—ensure they reflect the most compelling angles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Craft attention-grabbing subject lines and preview text
rubrics_metrics.description: Use AI to generate captivating subject lines and preview text; you can select and tailor suggestions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subject lines strongly affect open, click, and reply rates. Use the AI's algorithmic suggestions to avoid generic wording and improve engagement, but test and personalize to the recipient when possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Align pitch purpose and messaging with the release
rubrics_metrics.description: Select the purpose of your message (e.g., sharing survey results) and have AI create a custom pitch that matches that purpose and the content inside your press release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly state purpose so the pitch highlights appropriate angles; alignment reduces irrelevant outreach and increases chances of coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid spam-trigger wording and formatting errors
rubrics_metrics.description: Be mindful of words and formatting that increase the chance of ending up in spam folders; AI helps remember and avoid problematic phrasing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review subject lines, preview text, and email body for spam signals and poor formatting; AI can help but always double-check to maintain deliverability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personalize outreach and prioritize relationship-building
rubrics_metrics.description: While AI speeds up drafting and contact discovery, continue to build relationships and fine-tune strategy—human outreach and personalization remain essential.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use time saved by AI to do deeper research, personalize messages, and maintain ongoing relationships with journalists; don't rely solely on automated sends.
